title: Devil Summoner: Soul Hackers: Akuma Zensho Dainishuu
native_title: デビルサマナー ソウルハッカーズ 悪魔全書 第二集
overview: Devil Summoner Soul Hackers: Akuma Zensho Dainishuu is a monster database and sound gallery fan disc for Devil Summoner: Soul Hackers. It also includes a short sound-novel style prologue scenario not found in the main game, which is a linear visual novel that takes around an hour to complete.
